challenge.scenario: A Pro store owner loads a private Team Chat conversation they did not participate in.
challenge.finding: General support role or operator authority could leak internal private messages.
challenge.resolution: Verify can_read_office_thread_v1 enforces private.office_active_participant_v1 before scoped office.internal_chat capability.

challenge.scenario: A user switches tenant context while retaining a valid private thread identifier.
challenge.finding: Thread ownership across instances could leak another organization’s chat messages.
challenge.resolution: Ensure reader and participant checks share p_instance_id and office_threads composite id-instance binding.

challenge.scenario: A customer support agent opens a legitimate customer thread after participant RLS installation.
challenge.finding: Overly strict internal-only predicates could break ordinary customer support functionality.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical customer branch can_manage_support while independent internal Team Chat requires participant membership.

challenge.scenario: A browser attempts an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on an Office thread after new policies are installed.
challenge.finding: Old ALL policies or lingering direct grants could permit a client to mutate private workspace outside audited RPC.
challenge.resolution: Copy canonical policy replacement and revoke browser write privileges; require real auth role policy rehearsal.

challenge.scenario: An Office service-role function is invoked with forged actor UUID after canonical 0050 has been applied.
challenge.finding: RLS is bypassed by SECURITY DEFINER, and source-only checker might misstate actor authorization.
challenge.resolution: Do not claim live security PASS, require explicit authenticated actor/session proofs for RPC paths in final acceptance.

challenge.scenario: Legacy customer threads without participants are replayed by the new privacy backfill.
challenge.finding: Incorrect assignments can delete or omit support references or expose internal messages.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical idempotent backfill statements unchanged and require data shape checks on disposable target.

challenge.finding: CI would falsely certify incomplete modern Office privacy and Pro SQL hardening.
challenge.resolution: Keep snapshot-reviewed, freshInstallProofRequired=true and proofContractSha256 null until full chain.

A forward-only 0050 copy is essential but alone not safe to deploy without the later 0051+ privacy hardening, strict Pro tenancy and real role proof.
